description.en:
There have been frequent werewolf attacks in the village where the young boy Velou lives. Villagers are being killed and eaten one by one. The village chief makes up his mind and hires a hunter. However, a small girl appears in the village…!! Velou is suspicious of the girl, but shows her around the village. And then a werewolf appears…!?
___
**Official English Volumes:** [VIZ](https://www.viz.com/shonenjump/chapters/the-hunters-guild-red-hood)

**Notes:**
- Volume 2 includes oneshots [The Land of Hermit Crabs](https://mangadex.org/title/5eb94ba5-8f1f-4de6-80fc-290a052e5aad/yadokari-no-kuni) & [No Hope, No Pulse](https://mangadex.org/title/c949d6d1-7d35-4660-8b54-ca5fcd3c6e00/myakunashi) and a bonus chapter: Ironworks Iron Rule: Conserve Water!.
- Volume 3 includes [the oneshot version of the series](https://mangadex.org/title/dace5c92-43cd-4051-b5b2-8119a9110107/red-hood) and the Epilogue.
description.es-la: Los hombres lobo alguna vez fueron humanos que llevaban vidas normales, pero un día enloquecieron y comenzaron a anhelar la carne humana. Entre los cazadores que se dedican a erradicar a los hombres lobo existe la leyenda del famoso “Red Hood”.

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 川口勇貴

**Birthday:** March 17

Graduated from [the Soujou University Faculty of the Arts](https://www.sojo-u.ac.jp/faculty/arts/).

Worked as assistant on [My Hero Academia](https://mangadex.org/title/4f3bcae4-2d96-4c9d-932c-90181d9c873e/my-hero-academia) (formerly) & [The Elusive Samurai](https://mangadex.org/title/b6a5d154-7845-4129-b473-ba0aec3deffd/the-elusive-samurai) (from Vol 7).
